thread:
amanda_fin: Hey team — vendor just uploaded an invoice but they charged VAT (19%). Vendor says they're an umbrella company in Berlin and included a DE VAT ID that looks valid. Can tax confirm whether we should pay VAT or ask for a reissued invoice (reverse charge)? Invoice: INV-2026-089.

invoice-bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-2026-089.pdf (uploaded by vendor-berlin-umbrella) :page_with_curl: 

leo_sales: @amanda_fin did they include a PO? We normally don't accept VAT on contractor invoices unless they're a registered company.

vendor-berlin-umbrella: Hi Amanda — we are registered as a GmbH umbrella service. We charged VAT according to local rules. We can provide VAT registration certificate and company extract.

ingrid_tax: Quick Q — is this supply to our EU entity or to a non-EU entity? If this is an individual on umbrella payroll, VAT shouldn't apply. Paste invoice lines please.

amanda_fin: Sure, invoice lines copied below:
```
1x Consulting hours (Jan 2026) — 20,000 EUR
Subtotal 20,000.00 EUR
VAT 19% 3,800.00 EUR
Total 23,800.00 EUR
```

ingrid_tax: Thanks. Two actions: 1) Ask vendor for VAT registration certificate (USt-IdNr) and company registration (Handelsregister extract / Gewerbeanmeldung). 2) Confirm which Redwood legal entity is being billed — reverse charge depends on buyer registration. Also note: W-8/W-9 are for US withholding, not applicable here.

amanda_fin: @vendor-berlin-umbrella can you upload the VAT certificate and confirm whether payment should go to the GmbH (legal entity) or to an individual? If it's an individual, we may need to treat it differently re: withholding/gross-up.

vendor-berlin-umbrella: Uploaded VAT certificate and Handelsregister extract to the invoice thread. Payment should be to the GmbH (legal entity). Apologies for not having your VAT on file earlier.

leo_sales: If it's to a GmbH and the VAT ID validates, we can usually reclaim input VAT. But if this is cross-border within EU and reverse charge applies, vendor should not charge VAT. @ingrid_tax please validate via VIES and advise.

ingrid_tax: Running VIES check now — VAT ID returns valid. Next: confirm buyer VAT number on the invoice. Which Redwood entity is booking this?

amanda_fin: Booking to Redwood GmbH (we have a local entity). So reverse charge likely applies. Vendor should issue a credit note and reissue invoice without VAT with the reverse-charge note: 'Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers' (or English: 'reverse charge — VAT payable by the recipient').

vendor-berlin-umbrella: Understood. We'll reissue without VAT and add the reverse charge note. Reissue ETA: end of day tomorrow.

amanda_fin: Thanks — please include our Redwood GmbH VAT number on the invoice header when you reissue. If they can't reissue, we'll need a credit note + new invoice or we can reclaim via VAT return but it complicates bookkeeping.

ingrid_tax: Agreed. Once they reissue we'll close. If not received in 48h, finance escalate and we may withhold payment until corrected. :thinking_face: :white_check_mark:
